title: Uniform probability bound for DNF evaluation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates. Under the uniform distribution on the sign cube, the probability that $\varphi$ evaluates to $-1$ is at most the sum, over its terms $T$, of $2^{-\operatorname{width}(T)}$.
hypotheses_covered: Uniform distribution on the sign cube
